messages:
Maria Chen: Morning async — quick check-in for today.
Maria Chen: What I did: rolled KMS rotation script to staging, validated key access logs for `embed-service` and `ingest-pipeline`.
Maria Chen: Blockers: rotation for `embed-service` still shows old key in use (AccessDenied seen when agent tries to re-key).
Maria Chen: Today: investigate console vs terraform drift, coordinate with infra to redeploy key-agent, and run a staged rotation run.
Alex Park: Noted. I saw an `AccessDenied` error in the rotation logs at 03:12 UTC. I can pair after lunch to trace role permissions. Ping me when you're ready.
Alex Park: @Tanya Rivera — can you double-check whether the role `svc/embed-service-role` needs `kms:ReEncryptFrom`?
Jamal Singh: I ran `aws kms list-aliases --profile prod` and the alias mapping for embed-service looked stale (alias still points to old-key-2023). Opening PR to update terraform mapping: https://git.rwood/infra/pull/998
Tanya Rivera: On the PR — small nit: the policy needs explicit `kms:Decrypt` for the execution role; also verify cross-account trust if the ingest account assumes the role. I'll add inline comments.
Priya Nair: FYI security-scan-bot flagged 1 high-severity finding for `telemetry-worker` (secret-in-env). Looks like a false positive — the value is a hashed token. I'll file SEC ticket to suppress and harden rules: #SEC-432.
security-scan-bot: [scan] branch=main commit=5f3a2a findings=1_high,3_medium,6_low — https://scanner.internal/reports/5f3a2a
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: key-agent v2.1 -> staging (build #5678). ETA ~4m.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: key-agent v2.1 -> staging (build #5678) :tada:
Maria Chen: Update: found an inline policy in console attached to `svc/embed-service-role` that was overriding terraform. Removed it and re-applied infra. Will kick rotation in ~10m and post results. :thumbsup:
Jamal Singh: Good catch. If rotation still fails, fallback plan is to pin the service to the old key and schedule a maintenance window. Prefer to avoid, but good to have contingency.
Tanya Rivera: Quick reminder — compliance audit next Tue. We need to confirm KMS key audit log retention >= 90d and that key policy change history is archived. @Maria can you create a ticket to capture retention and runbook?
Maria Chen: Ticket created: https://tickets.rwood/SEC-758 — assigned to me. Also starting a draft runbook at /runbooks/kms-rotation.md (will link once ready).
Priya Nair: Who's owning the SOC2 encryption chapter? @Maria or @Tanya?
Maria Chen: I'll own the encryption section and will loop in @Priya for scanner exception docs and @Tanya for IAM policy writeups.
Alex Park: I'll jump into the PR review now. If anyone's free for a quick pair (20m) ping me — can help validate role assumptions.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. If rotation is green, please post a brief summary for the audit thread.
Maria Chen: Will do. Posting results in 15m.
deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly infra drift job runs at 02:00 UTC.
Maria Chen: Rotation completed: success. embed-service keys rotated, audit logs show re-wrap events for the two rotated keys. Closing loop — will update SEC-758 with artifacts. :white_check_mark:
Tanya Rivera: Awesome, thanks team.
Alex Park: Nice work.
Jamal Singh: :thumbsup:
